2191.  Row and Column Sums of a Matrix

40

Medium

Problem Statement
Read a matrix of integers and print the sum of each row and the sum of each column.
Description
A matrix (a table of numbers) with r rows and c columns is given. Find the sum of the numbers in each row and the sum of the numbers in each column, and print them.
input_spec: The first line contains two integers r and c, separated by a space. (1 <= r, c <= 5) Each of the next r lines contains c integers separated by single spaces. (Each integer is between -100 and 100)
output_spec: Print 2 lines. Line 1: the sums of the rows, from the first row to the last row. Line 2: the sums of the columns, from the first column to the last column. Print each result as a list in square brackets, with the numbers separated by a comma and a space, for example [6, 15].
